title: workspace-organizer configuration v1
$comment: Cross-entry overlap, exclusion, and sensitivity-precedence rules are enforced by the read-only contract validator.

default_sensitivity.description: The minimum sensitivity for reusable and adopted material; declarations can only make a path more restrictive.

adopted_task_paths.description: Exact, pairwise-disjoint task bundle roots. They must not overlap adopted material roots or be contained by an exclusion.

adopted_material_roots.description: Exact material roots. Nested roots are allowed only within this same ownership class; effective sensitivity is the most restrictive of the default and every containing declaration.

exclude_paths.description: Pairwise-disjoint roots that no loader or indexer may enter. A strict descendant may carve content out of a registered root; a registered root cannot be inside an exclusion.
